modules.name: road_round_internal_probe
modules.description: Registered deterministic source, production nearest-even rounding core, registered sink and observable checksum for an internal integration boundary.

ports.name: i_rstn
ports.description: External asynchronous active-low assertion into the two-register release synchronizer only

ports.name: o_result_valid
ports.description: One-cycle pulse for each result captured by the sink register boundary

ports.name: o_result_data
ports.description: Registered signed int16 result bit pattern; ignored on fault

ports.name: o_result_tag
ports.description: Registered source identity returned by the rounding core

ports.name: o_checksum
ports.description: XOR of normalized registered result tokens

ports.name: o_error
ports.description: Sticky mismatch between fault and the deterministic shift pattern

ports.name: o_result_count
ports.description: Number of result tokens incorporated into checksum

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: road_round_reset_gen_Inst_release.reg_reset_meta and reg_reset_release assert asynchronously; wire_core_rstn deasserts after two rising edges and resets every source, RNE, sink and summary register.

behavior: A registered 64-bit deterministic feedback source forms products by repeating its sign bit, restricting products to the signed 62-bit magnitude range and excluding INT64_MIN.
Registered tag low six bits provide shifts zero through sixty-three; shift sixty-three is the deliberate fault case, and every eighth source slot is an invalid bubble.
flag_advance is low for one clock in every four and freezes the source boundary and every road_round_shift stage; the stall phase itself remains free-running.
The staged road_round_shift keeps its canonical nine enabled-edge input-to-output behavior and II one on enabled clocks.
A sink register boundary captures data, tag and fault only on a common advance and exposes a one-cycle valid pulse.
Fault data is normalized to zero before the separate checksum-token register; checksum, count and sticky error update only for qualified tokens.
Reset cancels all in-flight source, core, sink and checksum tokens; the deterministic batch restarts from tag zero.
constraints: Verilog-2001 only and one i_clk domain; no gated clock.
Only paths from top-level i_rstn to asynchronous reset controls of road_round_reset_gen_Inst_release.reg_reset_meta and reg_reset_release may receive the external asynchronous-reset exception.
Paths from road_round_reset_gen_Inst_release.reg_reset_release through wire_core_rstn to the core and all source, sink and summary reset endpoints remain timed and must not be false-pathed.
The production road_round_shift source must remain byte-identical to its staged copy.
This fixture is not whole-CNN, synthesis timing, board, throughput or accuracy evidence.
corner_cases: Shift zero passes an integer product without fractional rounding.
Shift sixty-three returns a tagged fault and its unspecified data is zeroed only for checksum construction.
A common stall freezes source and core state without duplicating a sink transfer.
Asserting i_rstn during active tokens cancels them before the next clock; release takes two rising edges.
The final eighteen-row CNN tile issue is outside this arithmetic-only probe.
verification_cases: Python generates 192 deterministic source slots using production/round/reference.py::expected.
The testbench checks each registered source product, shift, tag and valid value.
The testbench checks all 168 returned result tags, faults and nonfault data values.
The testbench observes common stalls and proves representative source and core registers hold.
The testbench asserts reset with live tokens, checks immediate cancellation, two-edge release and clean sequence restart.
Final checksum, result count, fault count and sticky error match the Python report.

timing_diagrams.description: Internal reset releases after two clock edges; flag_advance then inserts a real common stall while registered results remain individually visible.

modules.name: road_round_reset_gen
modules.description: Dedicated asynchronous-assert two-register synchronous-release reset generator for the internal probe.

ports.name: o_rstn
ports.description: Active-low reset released after two rising edges

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: reg_reset_meta and reg_reset_release assert low asynchronously; o_rstn releases only after both rising-edge stages.

behavior: External reset asynchronously clears exactly reg_reset_meta and reg_reset_release.
After i_rstn rises, reg_reset_meta rises on the first clock and reg_reset_release rises on the second clock.
o_rstn is the direct published value of reg_reset_release.
constraints: Only the external i_rstn paths to these two asynchronous controls may receive an asynchronous reset timing exception.
The reg_reset_release to functional reset path remains timed.
Verilog-2001 and one clock domain only.
corner_cases: A short low pulse immediately clears both stages.
A reset reassertion during release cancels the release immediately.
verification_cases: Testbench observes the first and second release stages separately.
Reset reassertion with live functional tokens clears both stages immediately.

timing_diagrams.title: Asynchronous assertion and two-edge release
timing_diagrams.description: Assertion is immediate while release crosses two clocked stages.

modules.name: road_round_internal_probe_core
modules.description: Functional deterministic source, production nearest-even rounding core, registered sink and observable checksum behind an input reset boundary.

ports.name: i_rstn
ports.description: Stable active-low reset from the dedicated generator

ports.name: o_result_data
ports.description: Registered signed int16 result bit pattern

ports.name: o_checksum
ports.description: XOR of normalized registered result tokens

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: Every source, RNE, sink and summary register clears; the dedicated generator guarantees synchronous release.

behavior: The registered PRBS source produces 192 tagged slots, with every eighth slot invalid.
Tag low six bits provide shifts zero through sixty-three and shift sixty-three deliberately faults.
A registered common advance freezes the source and all road_round_shift stages one clock in four.
The result boundary exposes each accepted result and a later boundary updates checksum, count and sticky error.
constraints: i_rstn is a module input from road_round_reset_gen and is not generated in this functional module.
All combinational cones remain at most three operations and three sources.
The staged road_round_shift remains byte-identical to production.
corner_cases: Shift sixty-three returns a tagged fault.
Common stalls hold both source and core state.
verification_cases: Check all 168 returned tokens and three faults.
Check each common stall hold and reset cancellation.
Check the final checksum and result count.

timing_diagrams.title: Registered source and common stall
timing_diagrams.description: The registered advance freezes source and RNE state before results resume.

modules.name: road_round_shift
modules.description: Staged byte-identical production nine-stage globally enabled exact signed rounding and int16 saturation primitive.

ports.name: i_shift
ports.description: Right shift zero through sixty-two; sixty-three faults

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: Every pipeline register and valid bit clears to zero.

behavior: Nine enabled edges including acceptance produce output.
II is one enabled clock and invalid input inserts a bubble.
i_advance low freezes every pipeline register.
Nearest-even rounding restores sign and saturates to signed int16.
constraints: One clock domain and common clock enable.
corner_cases: Shift zero has no fractional increment.
verification_cases: Production reference covers all legal shifts and signed ties.
Internal probe checks continuous tokens, bubbles, common stalls, tags, faults and reset cancellation.

timing_diagrams.title: Enabled clocks and a common stall
timing_diagrams.description: Adjacent tokens retain order across a common stall.
